title: flow_seed_demand / Spawn_Intent parse accept any src/dst id with no live-node or distinctness check
detail: No guard rejects a non-live or src==dst demand id. A typo'd node id spawns a packet at a non-existent node; routing_next_hop then returns ok=false forever, so it silently never delivers and never renders (a ghost packet). Not triggered by current valid inputs.
recommended_fix: Validate src/dst at the lowering boundary (lower_spawns / app seed) where the Topology is available — reject non-live ids and src==dst with a typed error before flow_seed_demand, so no ghost packet is ever spawned.
